dedupe_keys.name: fuel scenario lab a falsifiable model of russian ai 95 gasoline supply under refinery strikes v1 18 4

description: Fuel Scenario Lab is an openly deposited deterministic weekly model of Russian AI-95 gasoline supply under refinery strikes. The provider describes 33 refineries with regional capacity and unit assumptions, 44 coded damaging events, 12 rejected events and eleven adjustable parameters. A public ZIP freezes the engine, dashboard and data at version 1.18.4, with event evidence reconciled to 12 September 2026. It produces station availability, rationing tiers, regional coverage and fiscal consequences for user-edited facility states. This can support resilience or supply-disruption scenarios for fuel infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this instrument. A limitation is that conflict reporting and capacity-loss rules are uncertain and change after the snapshot; the model provides falsifiable scenarios, not verified current availability at every station. The page describes pump-availability and replay checks, but this review did not reproduce either. Zenodo metadata states MIT for code and the provider description separates CC BY 4.0 data and prose. No archive was downloaded.
